AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-backend#610 @ d1e1732f0196490746ce9a09b7fc93685f29afdc — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

Full T4 audit (Opus lens) of the head as it stands. The branch is BEHIND main `10dff85c`; a merge-train delta follows at merge time.
- **Range:** merge-base `be667142..d1e1732f`, 4 commits, 46 files, no migration.
- **What I read:**
  - the safety service, content filter and controller;
  - every changed service method;
  - every community controller (each route's method, guards and roles);
  - the route-coverage guard;
  - push and realtime fan-out.
- Read-only and independent.

## Requested checks
- **Two-way block on read routes: PASS for every route under `src/community`.**
  - `hiddenFromViewer` queries both `blocker_id` and `blocked_id`.
  - List routes use `filterBlocked`; by-id routes use `assertVisibleTo`, which returns the route's own 404 body.
  - Coach-authored lessons, events, challenges and the Today event/challenge are filtered by creator.
  - Reaction lists, roster, leaderboard, wins, search and voice notes are filtered.
  - Reply pushes and event-reminder pushes skip blocked pairs (`community-events.service.ts:720-733`).
  - Realtime pings carry ids only, and the client re-reads through the filtered GETs.
- **Route-coverage guard: real, with limits (C-610-2).**
  - Routes are enumerated from Nest `PATH_METADATA` / `METHOD_METADATA` over every `*.controller.ts` under `src/community`, not from a hand-written list. Any GET it does not classify fails the suite, and stale entries fail too.
  - Each FILTERED route's named service method body must contain a filter call. The body extractor has its own self-test.
  - Each EXEMPT route needs a reason. All 13 exempt routes are coach/owner-only, static, or about the caller's own data; I checked each one's roles and service.
- **404 vs 403:**
  - Hidden content returns the same 404 body as missing content: posts, messages, voice, classroom, events, challenges, reactions.
  - Block targets outside the caller's workspaces return the same 404 as a nonexistent user.
  - DMs return 403 `community.dm.blocked` (C-610-1).
- **Ban:**
  - `banAuthor` refuses the workspace coach and a platform owner (`community-moderation.service.ts:325-342`). It runs before `hideTarget` and before the report is resolved, so a refused ban writes nothing.
  - A ban sets every membership in the workspace to `removed`. Every access check requires `active`, and the student bootstrap upsert uses `update: {}`, so it does not re-admit a banned member.
- **Content filter before writes:** applied to post create/edit, comment, cohort message send/edit, DM send and challenge comment. **Missing on member wins (B-610-1).**
- **First names only:**
  - roster: `rosterView` (email, status and joined date are null);
  - leaderboard and wins;
  - block list.

  Post, message and DM views carry author ids only. Coach and owner views keep full names.
- **DM report and react:** `assertDmParticipantIfDm` returns 404 to anyone who is not one of the two participants (`moderation.service.ts:163`, `reactions.service.ts:140`).
- **Voice notes:**
  - Upload-url and create are behind `CommunityVoiceEnabledGuard`, which is on only when `FEATURE_COMMUNITY_VOICE_NOTES === 'true'`. prod-switches.yml defaults it to OFF. That is the operator decision, and it holds.
  - The list, by-id and delete routes are not behind the voice flag. With the flag off, no rows can be created.
- **Coach-member block hiding coach content:** implemented and documented. A coach messaging block shares the `UserBlock` row. The operator accepted this.

## Findings
- **B-610-1: member wins are live UGC with no content filter and no report path.**
  - **Evidence:** `POST /community/wins` (`community.controller.ts:128`) accepts a free-text `title` (200 chars) and `description` (2000 chars). It is `@Roles('student')` with no `CommunityFeatureFlagGuard`.
  - **No filter:** `CommunityService.postWin` (`community.service.ts:451-472`) writes the text without `assertAllowed`.
  - **Who sees it:** `GET /community/feed` (`:421-446`) shows `title` to every client of the same coach. A client with no coach gets `{ visibility: 'public' }` wins from every tenant (`:426`), and any client can set `visibility: 'public'` through the API.
  - **No report target:** the report enum has no win member (`CommunityModerationTargetType`, schema.prisma:5679-5686).
  - **Live in the app with no flag:** mobile main and #314 show this screen as More > Community (`CommunityScreen` with `usePostWin`, MoreScreen.tsx:70-72), outside `featureFlags.communityTab`.
  - **Why it blocks:** blocking applies to wins, but filtering and reporting do not. Guideline 1.2 needs all three for every UGC surface.
  - **Minimal fix, either option:**
    - Gate `POST /community/wins` and `GET /community/feed` behind the community flag (off), and hide the More > Community row in mobile; this is the voice-note treatment.
    - Or keep the surface and:
      - add `this.safety.assertAllowed(data.title, data.description)` before the create;
      - add a report path for wins;
      - return `[]` for a client with no coach instead of other tenants' public wins.
- **C-610-1: the DM refusal discloses a block, and the blocker gets the wrong next step.**
  - A blocked pair gets 403 `community.dm.blocked`, but a missing thread gets 404 `community.dm.not_found`. So the blocked party can tell, which sits against the "they are not told" copy.
  - The blocker gets "You cannot message this member..." rather than "You blocked this member. Unblock them in Community safety to message them."
  - Recommended: give the blocker its own code and copy. For the blocked party, either return the not-found body or accept the inference.
- **C-610-2: limits of the guard.**
  - It covers GET routes under `src/community` only.
  - It checks that the named service method contains a filter call. It does not check that the controller handler reaches that method, or that the filtered result is the one returned.
  - Optional: also assert that each FILTERED handler's body calls the named service method.
- **C-610-3: the ban refusal body has no message.**
  - `{ error, code: 'community.moderation.cannot_ban_coach' }` has no `message`; mobile #314 maps the code.
  - The ban guard covers the workspace coach and platform owners only. A member whose membership role is `coach` or `assistant` can be banned by the workspace coach. That looks intended, but it is not written down.
- **C-610-4: the community DB suites skip without `COMMUNITY_TEST_DATABASE_URL`.**
  - The 8 `*.e2e.spec.ts` suites skip here, and I could not read the CI job log to confirm they run there.
  - The behavioural proof is the in-memory-Prisma suites, chiefly `community-block-two-way` and `community-safety-flow`.
- **Copy note:** the 13 strings checked have no exclamation marks or emoji. The default safety contact is the coach's own address.

## Evidence
- **Local at the exact head** (heavy.sh, `prisma generate`, then `env CI=false jest --runInBand`), the 22 spec files the PR changes.
  - Result: **14 suites passed (247 tests)**. The 8 DB e2e suites skipped (83 tests) because `COMMUNITY_TEST_DATABASE_URL` is unset.
- **CI at `d1e1732f`, all SUCCESS:** build-and-test, rls-floor-guard, rls-live-tests, mwb-3-live-tests, npm audit, CodeQL JS/TS, R75, build-sbom, danger and test-deploy-readiness.
- **CI at `d1e1732f`, other:**
  - deploy-readiness-gate SKIPPED.
  - Schema parity did not run, because the base predates it. The PR has no migration; parity runs at the merge-train delta.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#610 @ 9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9 — VERDICT: BLOCK

**Open A/B/C: 2/4/1.** Full exact-head diff, surrounding authorization/storage paths, migration/RLS policies and prior Opus RC findings reviewed; no production action or flag change. [Candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/610).

### A-610-1 — A forged voice key escapes the author's storage namespace
`src/community/voice/community-voice.service.ts:369-396,267-268` trusts a client `storage_key` after only `startsWith(user.id + '/')`; `voice-upload.provider.ts:231-254` passes it to the privileged storage signer. A key `<my-id>/../victim/secret.m4a` passes validation and publication, while the actual installed storage SDK constructs a request whose standard URL normalization addresses `voice-notes/victim/secret.m4a`, then returns that signed URL to the publishing caller. [Publish/signing code](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/src/community/voice/community-voice.service.ts#L354-L418), [privileged signer](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/src/community/voice/voice-upload.provider.ts#L231-L254).

Minimal fix: bind publication to an exact, canonical, server-issued upload/owner record; reject dot segments, alternate separators and encoded traversal before insertion and before every signing path, and verify the uploaded object matches the issued scope/metadata. Add real-SDK request-boundary regressions for forged and foreign keys: no row, no signing request, no cross-principal normalized URL. The independent bounded probe exercised the actual service/provider/SDK against fake fetch, not a production storage object; knowing another object's key must not grant access. [Affected boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/src/community/voice/community-voice.dto.ts#L100-L118).

### A-610-2 — Wins RLS still permits cross-tenant hidden/public reads and author unhide
Migration `20270211000000:1-21` only adds report enum values and `hidden_at`; the retained `20261213000000_rls_tier5_notifications_community/migration.sql:166,176` SELECT admits every authenticated caller for `visibility='public'` without hidden/block/workspace predicates, and UPDATE lets an author clear `hidden_at` or set public visibility. Existing public rows are not migrated, so the REST circle-only/filter fixes do not establish the promised data-layer privacy or moderation invariant for non-service RLS callers. [New migration](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/prisma/migrations/20270211000000_community_reports_voice_notes_and_wins/migration.sql), [retained policies](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/prisma/migrations/20261213000000_rls_tier5_notifications_community/migration.sql#L142-L181).

Minimal fix: migrate legacy public wins and align nonprivileged SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE with circle tenancy, hidden status and both-way blocking; prevent author mutation of moderator-owned hide state while preserving authorized author deletion and privileged moderation. Require populated non-BYPASSRLS tests for a hidden legacy-public win, another coach's viewer, both block directions and author unhide/visibility forgery. This finding is a direct policy/code trace, not a claimed local live-DB execution. [Policy evidence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/prisma/migrations/20261213000000_rls_tier5_notifications_community/migration.sql#L165-L181).

### B-610-1 — Prior wins safety finding only partially closed: visible members cannot always block/report
Text filtering, circle-scoped REST feed, win reports/hide and author deletion are implemented, but `community.service.ts:431-495` permits circle wins without cohort membership, while `safety/community-safety.service.ts:255-289,325-342` authorizes blocking solely through shared membership/owned workspaces. The actual-service probe produces `community.block.not_found` for two visible same-coach members when no shared membership rows exist; additionally wins routes lack the Community API feature guard while report/block routes have it, leaving live wins with unavailable safety controls when that switch is off. [Wins audience](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/src/community/community.service.ts#L431-L509), [block authorization](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/src/community/safety/community-safety.service.ts#L255-L342), [prior B-610-1](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/610#issuecomment-5942471860).

Minimal fix: give every authorized wins viewer working report/block authorization and keep safety available wherever wins remain available, including never-joined members; do not remove legitimate wins functionality. Add actual-controller zero-membership and flag-off tests, then assert hidden content in both directions. [Route seam](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/src/community/community.controller.ts#L104-L142).

### B-610-2 — A workspace ban is bypassable and banned members still read peer wins
`moderation/community-moderation.service.ts:465-491` encodes bans only in current cohort memberships; `CommunityRepository` bootstraps the selected default cohort independently. Adding/selecting another default cohort re-admits the banned user, and `community.service.ts:431-459` excludes removed authors, not a removed viewer. Both defects were reproduced against the actual services/repository with the in-memory fixture: banned viewer reads a peer win; after a new default is selected, bootstrap creates active membership and workspace access succeeds. [Ban implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/src/community/moderation/community-moderation.service.ts#L442-L495), [wins read](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/src/community/community.service.ts#L431-L459).

Minimal fix: make a durable workspace-level ban authoritative in every read/write/bootstrap path, independent of default cohort changes or absence of an active cohort; only explicit authorized reinstatement clears it. Test ban → new/archived/default cohort → bootstrap/read/post, including denied peer wins and unaffected bystanders. [Repository bootstrap](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/src/community/community.repository.ts).

### B-610-3 — A removed/banned voice author cannot delete their remaining notes
`voice/community-voice.service.ts:546-556` resolves deletion through `readableNote:465-488`, requiring current membership before checking authorship. After removal the actual-service probe returns `community.voice.not_found` for the author's own existing note and leaves `soft_deleted_at=null`; banning one target does not delete their other notes. [Delete and membership lookup](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/src/community/voice/community-voice.service.ts#L450-L556).

Minimal fix: permit authenticated own-content deletion independently of read membership/entitlement, retain indistinguishable foreign-target denial, and atomically suppress note/search/queue playback. Test own deletion after removal, ban and access expiry plus foreign-target controls. [Delete path](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/src/community/voice/community-voice.service.ts#L546-L556).

### B-610-4 — Warn resolves the report without reliably warning the member
`moderation/community-moderation.service.ts:365-405` records `warn` as actioned and uses only fire-and-forget push for its member-visible effect; `notifications/community-notifications.service.ts:143-149,186-198` exits before creating an inbox notification if the push flag is off or the member has no token. Thus a member who denies notification permission can receive no warning at all while the coach sees “Warning sent”; delivery/database errors are also swallowed after report resolution. [Warn action](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/src/community/moderation/community-moderation.service.ts#L365-L405), [notification gates](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/src/community/notifications/community-notifications.service.ts#L139-L260), [coach completion copy](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/41d829d7a788a30a03b22943402209be3448804a/src/screens/community/CoachCommunityModerationScreen.tsx).

Minimal fix: durably persist a member-readable, action-specific warning/notification intent atomically with resolution, independent of optional push; retry delivery from an idempotent outbox and distinguish queued from delivered in coach copy. Test push-off, no-token, persistence failure, process interruption and replay; the warn action must remain real functionality, not a dismissed report. [Current persistence boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9/src/community/moderation/community-moderation.service.ts#L365-L405).

### Prior RC dispositions / evidence / release
Prior C-610-1/2/3 are closed by specific unblock copy, controller guard regressions and coded coach-ban denial/documented moderator roles; **C-610-4 remains**: community live-DB suites are still skipped, not proven by the generic required RLS jobs. [Prior Opus findings](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/610#issuecomment-5942471860).

All nine required contexts plus Schema parity and both migration checks succeeded at this exact head; executed build CI reports **635 passed suites / 10,846 passing tests**, with **19 suites / 203 tests skipped and five todo**, and affected safety/voice/wins regression suites passed. Migration enum additions are explicitly irreversible; successful disposable schema roundtrip is not populated policy/data proof. [Build CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36966975858/job/110712745651), [Schema parity](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36966975810/job/110712745555), [migration checks](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36966975798/job/110712987225).

Independent command `node ops/evidence/AUD-SOL-110/backend610-boundary-probe.cjs` exited 0 and saved the affirmative boundary reproductions; it transpiles the exact-head services and uses an in-memory fixture/fake storage fetch, not Nest HTTP, native-device or live-DB acceptance. Native record/playback is a separate dependent #314 must-fix; audited voice reporting/moderation, real client/coach playback, both-way blocking, author deletion and staffed 24-hour response/device acceptance are required before the owner-mandated ON launch. [Dependent mobile candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/314), [current launch scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/610).

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-backend#610 @ 9e4b37958ea500b849cfad125b26f86a6ebeb3d9 — VERDICT: BLOCK

This is the second Opus lens, a T4 UGC re-audit after the fix round, measured against the owner's 20:32 scope: voice notes reportable and on at launch.
- **What I read:** `eeeeef89..b3d85071` (23 files) plus the surrounding storage, auth, ban, bootstrap, RLS and account-deletion paths.
- **Merges:** both merges are pure. `merge-tree` reproduces trees `c01e77fa` and `b4c1453b`. The head merges cleanly with main `7a6cfd82`.
- **Open A/B/C: 1/6/1.** Five of these confirm GPT-6.1 Sol's findings independently, and two are new.
- Read-only. Nothing was pushed and no flags were changed.

## Prior Opus findings (5942471860)
- **B-610-1 (wins): mostly closed.** The filter runs before the write (`community.service.ts:472`). Wins are a report target with Hide (`hidden_at`). The author can delete their own win. The feed is the coach's circle only, never another tenant (`:431-459`). What remains open is the RLS gap and the block/flag gap below.
- **C-610-1: closed.** A missing DM thread now returns the same body as a blocked one (`community-dms.service.ts`, `DM_NOT_FOUND = DM_UNAVAILABLE`), and the blocker gets specific copy.
- **C-610-2: closed.**
- **C-610-3: closed.** The ban refusal now carries a message (`community-moderation.service.ts:55-57`), and moderator roles are documented.
- **C-610-4:** carried; see below.

## Voice reporting, end to end: what holds
- `voice_note` and `win` are report targets (migration `20270211000000`, which sorts after main; Schema parity is SUCCESS at this head).
- Reporting follows the read rules (`:233-263`), and DM voice notes are refused (`community.voice.dm_not_supported`).
- The review queue signs a 15-minute playback link (`:60-61`, `:626-629`).
- Hide and Ban soft-delete the note and its transcript search row (`:698-711`). Author delete does the same (`community-voice.service.ts:552-554`).
- Block is enforced on list and get.
- The `storage_key` DTO now passes validation.

## Findings
- **A-610-1 (Sol): CONFIRMED. A forged voice `storage_key` escapes the caller's namespace and lets the service-role key sign any object.**
  - `create` checks only `startsWith(user.id + '/')` (`community-voice.service.ts:369`), and `noteView` signs `row.storage_key` with the privileged client (`:268`; `voice-upload.provider.ts:231-254`).
  - My probe (`ops/aud-opus2-110/probe_610_voice_traversal.spec.ts`, PASS):
    - `<me>/../../coach-media/<victim>/private.mp4` is accepted, stored and signed;
    - the installed `@supabase/supabase-js` sends `/object/sign/voice-notes/<me>/../../coach-media/...`, and WHATWG URL normalization turns that into `/storage/v1/object/sign/coach-media/<victim>/private.mp4`.
  - The result is a signed URL to another bucket's object, returned to the caller.
  - Hidden or deleted notes keep their objects (next finding), so a known key also lets someone republish moderated audio.
  - **Fix:**
    - store and accept only the exact key that upload-url issued, bound to the caller (or validate against `^<uid>/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$` with no `..`, `%2e`, `\` or `//`);
    - re-check the same rule before every sign;
    - add a regression covering these keys: dot segment, encoded, foreign and other-bucket.
- **B-610-5 (new): delete, hide and account deletion never erase the recording.**
  - Author delete and moderation Hide/Ban are soft deletes only. Nothing in `src/` removes a voice object (`rg "\.remove\(" src/community/voice` is empty).
  - Account deletion erases `CommunityWin` (`account-deletion.service.ts:797`) but never touches `CommunityVoiceNote`, its search rows or the bucket. The user row is tombstoned, so no cascade fires.
  - So a deleted client's voice keeps playing in the Hall.
  - With voice on at launch, this contradicts "client delete and account deletion still erase" (OR-110-1) and Apple 5.1.1(v).
  - **Fix:**
    - on account deletion: soft-delete every note and search row by the user, and remove `voice-notes/<uid>/*`;
    - on author delete: remove the object;
    - on hide/ban: remove the object after the report closes, keeping a non-media audit record;
    - add tests.
